_comment: Canonical stage registry (docs/metrics/STAGE_EVENTS.md). Every pipeline stage that can be timed is listed here with its producer and how it is measured. status: derived = computed by the shipping-slo collector from durable receipts (GitHub, Linear), so history backfills automatically; pushed = a live emitter writes jovie-stage-event/v1 rows; spec = emitter specified for its owner, not live yet; gap = no source exists. scripts/stage-manifest-check.mjs fails CI when a release/controller/deploy workflow is not registered here.

shipping.description: One unit of shipped work: Linear issue to production-verified PR.

stages.meaning: Linear issue created
issue entered Todo (unstarted) and became admissible
a lane claimed the issue (moved to started)
lane worker process started on the issue
pull request created
pull request ready for review (non-draft)
last admission to the merge queue before merge
pull request merged to main
first production promotion completed at or after merge
first Production Verified job completed at or after deploy

remediation.description: A red pull request returning to green.

stages.meaning: first failing GitHub Actions check suite on a PR commit
lane-fix-<kind> label applied after the red
fix-red lane run started
first later commit whose check rollup is SUCCESS

release.description: One main generation from staging to production verification.

stages.meaning: Staging Controller run started for the generation
staging Canary Health Gate started; exits when production promotion starts
Promote to Production started; exits at Production Verified
Production Verified job completed

ios-release.description: LogYourBody iOS build from merge to App Store release.

stages.meaning: iOS Release Loop run created for the merged main commit
Deploy to TestFlight job completed
Deploy to App Store job completed (submitted for review)
App Store version released to customers

revenue-funnel.entityId: pseudonymous user id (never leaves the app; only aggregates are published)
revenue-funnel.description: Artist acquisition to the paid $12 profile.

stages.meaning: first-touch acquisition journey captured
user row created
user_profile_claims.claimed_at
checkout_initiated server analytics event
first paid billing event

automation-run.entityId: <automationId>@<runRef> (registry id in canon/automation-registry.jsonl plus the run's own reference)
automation-run.description: One run of a registered automation, from start to its terminal receipt, as observed by the dead-man liveness check.

stages.meaning: the automation's run started (from its receipt)
the run reached a terminal receipt (completed or failed)

summer-turn.description: One Summer turn from triggering event to measured outcome.

stages.meaning: trigger received by Summer ingress
model call started
tool/action dispatched
terminal receipt with outcome recorded

github-pr.description: GraphQL merged-PR search with timeline items and commit check suites (28d window).

github-controller.description: Staging/Production Controller runs and their jobs.

github-lyb.description: JovieInc/LogYourBody iOS Release Loop runs and jobs; unavailable when the token cannot read that repo.

linear-history.description: Linear issue createdAt/startedAt/state history for JOV identifiers found on merged PRs; needs LINEAR_API_KEY.

exempt.ci-shard-contract-canary.yml: contract self-test, not a delivery stage
exempt.fixed-runner-canary.yml: runner health probe, not a delivery stage
exempt.pr-preparation-canary.yml: harness self-test, not a delivery stage
exempt.runner-autoscaler-canary.yml: runner health probe, not a delivery stage
exempt.m2-revenue-path-canary.yml: synthetic revenue probe; gap tracked in the stage gap audit
exempt.production-controller-health.yml: controller liveness monitor; measures the controller, not a stage
exempt.postdeploy-probes.yml: manual re-run of production probes; production-controller.yml owns the stage
exempt.desktop-release.yml: desktop app release; gap tracked in the stage gap audit
exempt.jovie-agent-release.yml: agent package release; gap tracked in the stage gap audit
exempt.ios-testflight.yml: Jovie iOS TestFlight; gap tracked in the stage gap audit
exempt.ios-app-store-graphics.yml: store asset generation, not a delivery stage
exempt.shipping-origin.yml: origin receipt writer consumed by shipping attribution
